note: rarity -> when a piece gains a substat, in the artifact's own +0..+20 levels. `upgrade_levels` is converted from the 1-indexed `addPropLevels` the table publishes; `raw_add_prop_levels` is what it published, so the conversion can be checked rather than trusted. `initial_substat_counts` is every `appendPropNum` seen at that rarity, treating an omitted key as the zero these dumps do not write — a piece rolls with one of them, and which one is not knowable from the catalogue. `excluded_unupgradable` counts the setless starter relics that carry no addPropLevels at all.
